parts.name: fa0
parts.spec: Full‑adder for the least‑significant bit: computes sum0 = a0 xor b0 xor cin0 and cout0 = majority(a0,b0,cin0).

parts.name: fa1
parts.spec: Full‑adder for the middle bit: computes sum1 = a1 xor b1 xor cin1 and cout1 = majority(a1,b1,cin1) where cin1 is the carry from fa0.

parts.name: fa2
parts.spec: Full‑adder for the most‑significant bit: computes sum2 = a2 xor b2 xor cin2 and cout2 = majority(a2,b2,cin2) where cin2 is the carry from fa1; cout2 is the chip’s carry‑out.
